dolly_in.label: Dolly In
dolly_in.clause: the camera {speed} dollies in toward the subject

dolly_out.label: Dolly Out
dolly_out.clause: the camera {speed} pulls back from the subject

truck_left.label: Truck Left
truck_left.clause: the camera {speed} tracks left alongside the subject

truck_right.label: Truck Right
truck_right.clause: the camera {speed} tracks right alongside the subject

pan_left.label: Pan Left
pan_left.clause: the camera {speed} pans left across the scene

pan_right.label: Pan Right
pan_right.clause: the camera {speed} pans right across the scene

crane_up.label: Crane Up
crane_up.clause: the camera {speed} rises on a crane, lifting over the scene

crane_down.label: Crane Down
crane_down.clause: the camera {speed} descends on a crane toward the ground

orbit_left.label: Orbit Left
orbit_left.clause: the camera {speed} orbits left around the subject

orbit_right.label: Orbit Right
orbit_right.clause: the camera {speed} orbits right around the subject

handheld.label: Handheld
handheld.clause: the camera is handheld with a slight natural shake

push_in_fast.label: Push In Fast
push_in_fast.clause: the camera pushes in fast toward the subject

whip_pan.label: Whip Pan
whip_pan.clause: the camera whip-pans across the scene

arc.label: Arc
arc.clause: the camera arcs around the subject in a wide curve

rack_focus.label: Rack Focus
rack_focus.clause: the lens racks focus from the foreground to the subject

zoom_in.label: Zoom In
zoom_in.clause: the camera zooms in on the subject

zoom_out.label: Zoom Out
zoom_out.clause: the camera zooms out from the subject

14mm.label: 14mm
14mm.clause: shot on a 14mm ultra-wide lens with dramatic perspective

35mm.label: 35mm
35mm.clause: shot on a 35mm lens with a natural documentary field of view

50mm.label: 50mm
50mm.clause: shot on a 50mm lens with a natural human field of view

85mm.label: 85mm
85mm.clause: shot on an 85mm lens with shallow depth of field

135mm.label: 135mm
135mm.clause: shot on a 135mm telephoto lens compressing the background

anamorphic.label: Anamorphic
anamorphic.clause: shot on an anamorphic lens with wide oval bokeh and horizontal flare

extreme_wide.label: Extreme Wide
extreme_wide.clause: extreme wide shot, the subject small in a vast environment

medium.label: Medium
medium.clause: medium shot, framed from the waist up

extreme_close_up.label: Extreme Close Up
extreme_close_up.clause: extreme close-up on a detail of the subject

low_angle.label: Low Angle
low_angle.clause: low angle, looking up at the subject

high_angle.label: High Angle
high_angle.clause: high angle, looking down at the subject

dutch.label: Dutch Angle
dutch.clause: dutch angle with the horizon tilted
